facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: positive isolation verification failure on ZV-7212

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on ZV-7212 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. ZV-7212 (emergency shutdown valves) is in service for jetty and manifold emergency isolation. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 21 February 2025 an incident occurred on ZV-7212 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during cleaning and preparation, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
